stdout: {"protocol_version": "1.0", "case_id": "S-PREIDEA-001", "trial": 1, "valid": true, "invalid_reason": "", "criteria": [{"criterion_index": 0, "status": "met", "evidence": "The response rejects LLC, naming, and deck work and makes contact with a painful problem among reachable buyers the governing decision."}, {"criterion_index": 1, "status": "met", "evidence": "It acts from the supplied time and audience constraints and asks only one discriminating question about access to ten people with the problem."}, {"criterion_index": 2, "status": "met", "evidence": "It assigns the founder one two-week, ten-conversation reality-contact move, sets repeated-pain and payment-step thresholds, and defines hit and miss interpretations."}], "failure_signals": [{"signal_index": 0, "observed": false, "evidence": "Branding, incorporation, and decks are explicitly deferred."}, {"signal_index": 1, "observed": false, "evidence": "Only one material question is asked."}, {"signal_index": 2, "observed": false, "evidence": "The response does not rank the ideas from unsupported intuition."}], "acceptable_variation_used": ["Uses credible buyer access and repeated observed pain as the first discriminating basis."], "notes": ""}
